cn.t: Critics celebrate this joyful all-male production, with Jonathan Groff earning widespread praise for his RSC debut as Rosalind. Reviewers laud Evans' inventive direction, the production's wit and charm, and its fresh exploration of Shakespeare's gender-fluid comedy.
